edges.reason: releaseStartTime_ is used to compute _releaseStartTime in the constructor.
daysOfTimelock_ scales the release window in the constructor.
totalBenefit_ initializes _totalBenefit in the constructor.
token_ initializes the immutable _token in the constructor.
beneficiary_ initializes the immutable _beneficiary in the constructor.
Constructor assigns the token state variable.
Constructor assigns the beneficiary state variable.
Constructor assigns the release start time.
Constructor assigns the release end time.
Constructor assigns the total benefit.
Constructor zeroes the withdrawed balance.
Constructor sets the terminated flag to false.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
Normalized release start time feeds the schedule arithmetic used for releases.
block.timestamp controls the elapsed day arithmetic determining released funds.
Arithmetic result is returned as the released balance value.
Day constant divides timestamps in releasedBalance math.
releasedBalance reads _releaseStartTime.
releasedBalance reads _releaseEndTime.
releasedBalance uses _totalBenefit for proportional computation.
Timestamp comparisons select the release branch in releasedBalance.
passedDays local is derived and used in the returned proportion.
totalDays local is used as divisor in the returned proportion.
unreleasedBalance subtracts the result of releasedBalance.
_totalBenefit is the minuend in unreleasedBalance subtraction.
withdraw gate depends on the time-based releasedBalance value.
withdraw reads and updates _withdrawedBalance before the external transfer.
withdraw computes the local amount to transfer.
Local amount is applied to the withdrawed balance update.
withdraw increases _withdrawedBalance before the external call.
withdraw performs an external safeTransfer token call.
The transfer unsafe operation invokes the token state variable.
The transfer unsafe operation sends tokens to _beneficiary.
The token external call transfers control and may re-enter withdraw.
withdraw is public and callable by any account.
msg.sender determines who can trigger withdraw.
terminate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
terminate is guarded by the isNotTerminated modifier.
onlyOwner compares owner() against msg.sender.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to access control logic.
terminate derives _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp.
Termination arithmetic writes the reset release end time.
Termination arithmetic yields the amountToWithdraw value.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with the released balance.
terminate sets the terminated flag to true.
terminate performs an external safeTransfer token call to owner.
Local amountToWithdraw is the value transferred by the unsafe operation.
The termination transfer invokes the token state variable.
Tokens are transferred to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership delegates the update to _setOwner.
newOwner parameter is validated and passed to _setOwner.
newOwner parameter becomes the new owner value.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
oldOwner local captures the prior owner for the event.
renounceOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner with the zero address.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable.
withdrawedBalance() returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
isNotTerminated modifier reads the _isTerminated flag.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ only feeds core constructor state initialization.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ only scales the release window inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ only initializes _totalBenefit in the constructor.
Constructor parameter token_ only initializes the immutable token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ only initializes the immutable beneficiary state variable.
Local amount exists only to compute and transfer value inside withdraw.
Local passedDays exists only within releasedBalance schedule arithmetic.
Local totalDays exists only as the divisor inside releasedBalance.
Local amountToWithdraw exists only to size the owner transfer inside terminate.
Parameter newOwner only feeds the owner update path of transferOwnership.
Local oldOwner only records the prior owner for the _setOwner event.
